field.label: Enabled
field.help: This will enable or disable this zone.

field.label: View
field.help: Assign this zone to a BIND view. Required when views are enabled.

field.label: Zone Name
field.help: Set the name for this zone. Both forward and reverse zones may be specified, i.e. example.com or 0.168.192.in-addr.arpa.

field.label: Allow Transfer
field.help: Define the ACLs where you allow which server can retrieve this zone.

field.label: Allow Query
field.help: Define the ACLs where you allow which client are allowed to query this zone.

field.label: Primary IP
field.help: Set the IP address of primary server.

field.label: Transfer TSIG Key
field.help: Select a shared BIND TSIG key. The same key authenticates primary transfers and NOTIFY and can also be selected by BIND views. Preferred over the legacy inline transfer-key fields below.

field.label: Legacy Transfer Key Algorithm
field.help: Legacy inline TSIG algorithm. Leave empty when Transfer TSIG Key is selected.

field.label: Legacy Transfer Key Name
field.help: Legacy inline TSIG name. Leave empty when Transfer TSIG Key is selected.

field.label: Legacy Transfer Key Secret
field.help: Legacy inline Base64 TSIG secret. Leave empty when Transfer TSIG Key is selected.

field.label: Allow Notfiy
field.help: A list of allowed IP addresses to receive notifies from (in addition to the primary server.)
